grounding.quote: The minimum ticket status model is `backlog`, `active` and `completed`.

`backlog`
is accepted durable work that should remain visible but is not part of the
current execution focus; `active` is the current bounded execution set;
`completed` is closed work retained as history.

concepts.label: Ticket status and lane
concepts.definition: Declared ticket states minimally comprise backlog, active and completed. Their corresponding lanes mean accepted durable work outside current execution focus, the current bounded execution set, and closed work retained as history. State labels are not evaluation results.

grounding.quote:
The required fields are `migration_strategy`, with the values
`inside_out_hard_break` and `fundamental_re_adoption`

concepts.label: Migration strategy
concepts.definition: A declared migration-strategy field with values inside_out_hard_break and fundamental_re_adoption; the value is a carrier state, not a core result.

grounding.quote:
An implementation migration ticket declares whether the active boundary is
rebuilding a pattern locally, consuming an existing reusable library or
commonisation surface, or extending that surface before the local
implementation lands; `library_usage` records which

concepts.label: Library usage declaration
concepts.definition: A declared library_usage field, with none, consume and extend values, recording whether an active migration boundary rebuilds locally, consumes an existing reusable library/commonisation surface, or extends that surface before local implementation lands.

grounding.quote:
The checklist is a named walk of every live
interface that can still bypass, reinterpret, replay or project the
migrating truth path

concepts.label: Impacted Interface Review Checklist
concepts.definition: A named walk of every live interface capable of bypassing, reinterpreting, replaying or projecting the migrating truth path, with interface-specific closure assertions.

grounding.quote:
a
`Break-To-Closure Map` stating which break closes which closure-law clause;

concepts.label: Migration break order and closure map
concepts.definition: Required Break Order, or an equivalent ordered execution section, running outward from authoritative source truth: discover the full best-guess interface family; publish/admit the new carrier; deliberately sever and keep broken one old authoritative seam; rebind the deepest semantic kernel; remove/demote old producers; rebind old consumers; reprice projections, reports, prompts, delivery bindings and tests. With several old interfaces, a Break-To-Closure Map identifies the closure-law clause discharged by each break.
conditions: Implementation migration touches a core interface.

grounding.quote:
Authority to author or implement a change is not independent authority to
verify it.

concepts.label: Independent assessment
concepts.definition: Assessment independent of the author of the exact reviewed subject, with subject, basis, scope, exclusions, evidence, verdict and unresolved findings identified. Authoring authority and independent verification authority differ.

grounding.quote:
A residual judgment that another activation needs is recorded once, with
its owning work, in the existing carrier selected under §5.

concepts.label: Recorded residual judgment
concepts.definition: A once-recorded judgment attached to its owning work in the existing selected carrier, identifying the question, exact subject and basis, supporting computed facts/evidence, responsible actor and authority, scoped conclusion, uncertainty and concrete revising observation. Rule-settled questions require no invented J record.
conditions: A residual judgment is needed by another activation.

grounding.quote:
A direct or lawfully proxied owner ruling is recorded in its original
wording, with its owner, exact subject and basis, permitted scope and
effects, conditions and source, separately from agent interpretation.

concepts.label: Owner ruling
concepts.definition: A direct or lawfully proxied owner ruling retained in original wording with owner, exact subject and basis, permitted scope/effects, conditions and source, separately from agent interpretation. It is distinct from residual judgment.

grounding.quote:
The four repricing dispositions are lifecycle states of an obligation,
set by its owning authority. A state label is not an evaluation result and
has no automatic core mapping.

concepts.label: Material repricing decision
concepts.definition: The owner's separate authorized act establishing retained, superseded, deferred or withdrawn for an exact obligation, subject and basis. These four dispositions are lifecycle states without automatic core mappings. A material decision record identifies disposition, owner/grant, governing conditions, evidence, affected dependencies, remaining obligations and revisiting conditions.

grounding.quote: | `repricing_indeterminate` | indeterminate | admissible evidence cannot decide whether the decision meets an applicable condition; the undecided condition and needed evidence remain explicit |

concepts.label: Repricing evaluation result
concepts.definition: Evaluation of whether the named owner lawfully establishes the disposition for the exact obligation, subject and basis, satisfying all applicable conditions and preserving every surviving obligation. repricing_established maps to satisfied; repricing_falsified to falsified; repricing_indeterminate to indeterminate; repricing_out_of_frame to out_of_frame; repricing_invalid_basis to invalid_basis. These concern repricing legality, not candidate acceptance or delivery.
conditions: An evaluation of the owner decision is actually performed.

grounding.quote:
A work claim is complete only when every applicable declared obligation is
satisfied by valid evidence for its exact subject, basis and scope;

concepts.label: Work claim
concepts.definition: A bounded work claim with declared obligations, exact subject/basis/scope, required judgments and owner rulings, evidence and non-closure conditions. Its completion is condition-based; reviewer occurrence or a status label is not completion.

grounding.quote: Tests are proof projections from admitted work authority.

concepts.label: Ticket-local test case
concepts.definition: A proof projection from admitted work authority. A substantive test should derive through ticket, intake triage, lawful re-entry, and governing requirement/design/module/published function/carrier/closure surface to its expectation.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises, which the commitments do
not supply, are named in the rows

concepts.label: F13 work-carrier derivation and consumer index
concepts.definition: F13 is the source's work-carrier derivation family, tracing carrier selection, claims and closure to commitments and instance premises: differing lifetimes, competing-looking surfaces, multiple tenants, migrations and variable carriers. Its table reports P0 as recovered; P1/P2/P3/P4a/P6 as independent; P4b as derived from P0/P2 under non-reacquirable step facts; P5 as derived from P0/P6 under an open-world premise. It distinguishes derived consequences from member choices and external owners; it does not itself decide the linked owners' questions.

grounding.quote:
These shapes are the recommended carriers of the fields and sections the
rules above require;
- closure_law: migration closes only when the old projection is no longer authoritative within the affected scope and mixed old/new proof does not count as acceptance

concepts.label: Recommended carrier templates
concepts.definition: Three recommended document shapes carrying the earlier required fields/sections: a sprint manifest, ordinary ticket and implementation migration ticket. The sprint example SPRINT-2026-04-30-operational-projection concerns layout/readability/interaction/evidence iteration, excludes product truth/data contracts/runtime-governance changes/new constructive carriers, declares realization_refactor, records UXI-001 screenshot evidence and pending contrast debt, and closes by walkthrough with explicit escrow/paydown. Ordinary example T-001 is an active feature/product_reprice at product re-entry to make the Product layer explicit, requiring PRODUCT.md, intent -> product -> requirements bootstrap and reconciled examples/reconstruction. Migration example B-010 is an active bug/design_reframe at design_surface, inside_out_hard_break, library_usage none with boundary-specific rationale; it replaces synthetic fallback gap truth with declared-obligation projection plus separately classified fallback gaps on the operator-query acceptance path, explicitly declares no disjoint scope, lists old/new producers, consumers and derived surfaces, and repeats the migration checklist. These are examples, not instantiated work records or proof that their claims hold.

grounding.quote:
that `rg`
is sufficient for finding active work; and that no database or board is
required

concepts.label: Default local-file operating mode
concepts.definition: Humans and agents directly read the active folder; backlog remains searchable durable work without competing for immediate attention. The model assumes rg suffices to find active work and requires neither database nor board. Supplied shell lines illustrate searches for headings/status/type/goal and ticket identifiers; they are documentary examples.
conditions: The default local-file carrier is selected.

grounding.quote: Each surface answers one question (P3, P6).

concepts.label: Work-surface role separation
concepts.definition: Distinct surface roles: goals identify the current broad work wave; SPEC_METHOD identifies constitutional change class/re-entry; sprints price bounded-batch proof/evidence/paydown; tickets hold durable work units and state; comments record proposals, argument, decisions, review and handoff; POSTING_GUIDE specifies comment publication structure/naming. This separation prevents overloaded goal backlogs, diluted active focus, informal comment status and accidental board authority.

a `frontier_projection`
judgment judges a `Projection` record and is not an
Availability is not adoption.

concepts.label: Traversal occurrence profile
concepts.definition: Tier-3, application-neutral model-family signature for immutable application histories over externally mutable subjects. Stable concept identity: urn:stdo:concept:traversal-occurrence-profile; owning bounded context: urn:stdo:bounded-context:traversal-occurrence-profile. It imports one exact a_c basis without amending a_c, becoming universal, or importing consumer identities. Occurrence, lineage, EventFrontier, SemanticAdmissionCut and Projection are profile-specific meanings, not core release cuts/product lineage or other members' frontiers; frontier_projection judges a Projection record and is not AC-011 projection.
conditions: Adoption is optional and belongs to the adopting Product.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises hold where a Product adopts the profile; they are
adopted with it and do not follow from the foundations

concepts.label: F19 premises, consequences and owners
concepts.definition: Material family F19 imports F3 results/combination and F9 a_c under PROFILES §1. Adopted premises are I1 externally changing subject reality with stable binding, I2 one exact a_c basis, and I3 separately identified effects under owner-issued grants; these premises do not follow from foundations. Reported commitment standing is P0 recovered; P1/P3/P6 independent; P4b derived from P0/P2; P5 derived from P0/P6. The table separates consequences, profile policy choices and adopting-Product choices, with an internal consumer index.
conditions: The Product adopts the profile and its instance premises.

concepts.definition: The profile represents an immutable occurrence per exact traversal application; stable external subject binding; bounded pre/post observations; intended typed outcomes; separately authorized operations/evidence; immutable admitted framework-event facts; candidate claims, judgments and materialized typed relations; explicit frontiers and frontier-bound projections; distinct identity dependency, causal subgraphs and wider typed lineage.

This is subject-defined notation, not an operation performed by this interpretation.

not

Member choices include carrier kinds/selection table, minimum fields/types/categories/statuses/lanes, offering sprints, escrow lists/result mappings, tenant suffixes, migration declarations/checklists/strategy/library values/thresholds/review questions/break order, four repricing states/predicate, five-step test reconciliation, recommended shapes/search defaults and bounded reading policy. Product definition owns carrier locations/rebinding and tenant registry; governing method owns whether debt may survive; POSTING_GUIDE owns post categories/structure/states. Admission step law, migration law, independent assessment/reuse, result conjunction/general test law and semantic resolution remain owned by the cited external sections. Consumers add no deciding authority. A credible recurrence requires review, not automatic commonisation or identity merging.
constraints.uncertainty: The table states derivations and ownership; their external foundation standing and unsupplied owner clauses are not independently established.

a constructor's self-review is construction
output

Constructor self-review is construction output; this member states work-carrier consequences without taking ownership of those generic laws.

grounding.quote:
a new
role or conversation alone invalidates nothing.

constraints.statement: Later roles/runs recover judgments and check applicability rather than reauthor unchanged conclusions. Changed material facts/evidence, declared revising observation or basis invalidate affected results; preserve originals and successor links, retaining only demonstrably independent results and reassessing affected scope. Current C may be referenced but unknown facts cannot become established premises by reuse. Owner rulings are reused without widening or asking unchanged authority again; new ambiguity or material decision change returns only the affected question to owner. J is not O; recording either creates no admission, acceptance, effects or continuation beyond grant. Results follow selected run/sprint/ticket and named evidence-surface lifetime, without a separate registry, ticket per judgment or extra approval ceremony.
constraints.uncertainty: Full C/J/O annotation and generic reuse definitions are external.
exceptions: Required independent assessment must acquire sufficient exact evidence and supply its own independent judgment; reusing author J does not meet independence.

grounding.quote: An evaluation that was not performed has no result.

constraints.statement: Repricing gives each affected obligation a retained/superseded/deferred/withdrawn disposition with owner and evidence in the same carrier; preserves surviving work, explains changed dependencies and does not copy unaffected history to parallel ledgers. Present owner decisions as short consequence deltas with original ruling separate; generic continuation does not accept undisclosed architecture/scope change. Performed repricing evaluation retains decision/state/evidence and all applicable failure grounds: established requires exact owner authority/evidence/conditions and surviving-obligation preservation; falsified requires a counterexample including exceeding grant or violating obligation; indeterminate retains undecided condition/needed evidence; out_of_frame retains undeclared material relation/capability; invalid_basis covers absent/stale/ambiguous/mismatched required basis. No performed evaluation means no result. Evaluation grants no decision authority; only authorized owner act changes state. Lawful deferral may satisfy repricing while delivery remains failed/outstanding. Unauthorized withdrawn cannot close; retention or satisfied repricing proves no delivery; supersession/deferral/withdrawal erase no unresolved obligation/evidence.

Each exact application is immutable; changed-input reapplication creates a new occurrence and corrections append without erasure. Observations/events/projections describe rather than replace external subject reality; snapshot/rollback requires separate Product authorization. Effects require matching admitted grants, with functor/traversal/operation/executor/actor/grant/invocation distinct. Candidate, judgment, admitting event and materialized relation remain separate; precedence orders admitted facts without deciding authority. Cause requires admitted typed lineage; identity/causal subgraphs are acyclic so lineage walks reach first cause. Projection binds complete frontier; new event produces new frontier, never advances an old projection. Cut members share exactly one source frontier; successor equals that frontier plus exactly admitted event; missing/inconsistent members refuse; projection cannot be read beyond its frontier. Every judgment decision/stop and effect disposition for an effect-intending occurrence maps to exactly one core value for a named predicate. Undecidable effect outcome remains indeterminate; established non-attainment is falsified whether or not its end is established; no refusal maps to success.
